run_preprocess_relaxed_cli: run the CLI script to preprocess relaxed trajectory files into LMDB graph feature databases for S2EF
run_write_images_to_lmdb: run write_images_to_lmdb to convert ASE trajectory samples into pickled graph objects stored in an LMDB database
run_main_preprocess: run main to chunk trajectory files across workers and extract graph features using AtomsToGraphs into LMDB
refactor_write_images_to_lmdb: refactor write_images_to_lmdb to customize the LMDB map size, atom tag extraction, or data object fields
review_main_multiprocessing: review main to understand how trajectory files are split across multiprocessing workers for parallel LMDB writing
